## Context

Implement the operator-approved F01, F06, and F07 proposals from the documentation audit recorded on minimum-rainy-fawn. F02, F03, and F04 were rejected and remain outside scope. F05 is preserved as deferred research on biophilic-suicidal-cusimanse and remains outside scope.

## Historical basis

Ticket forworn-zanyish-narwhale introduced generated markers and the current generated-artifact tables after repeated edits targeted derived files. Ticket mucky-like-elkhound introduced the current top-level docs index and dead-link gate. This epic preserves those enforcement mechanisms while separating policy, navigation, and validation into dependency-ordered changes. No ADR introduced an architectural invariant for this scope.

## Implementation allocation

F01 owns the lossless relocation of the existing hand-maintained generated-artifact tables and their focused tests into docs/generated-artifacts.md. This relocation lets the approved F06 landing page remain a navigation surface. It does not generate the catalog, change catalog ownership, infer generated outputs, or implement the deferred F05 descriptor design. F05 remains the only proposal that could replace the hand-maintained catalog with mechanical rendering after a later decision. F06 owns only the subsequent docs/README.md navigation rewrite.

## Plan

- F01 defines documentation ownership and relocates the existing generated-artifact inventory without changing its records.
- F06 rewrites the documentation landing page after F01 establishes the policy and inventory destinations.
- F07 expands deterministic documentation index and relative-link validation after F06 establishes the maintained directory structure.

## Exclusions

- No general prose validator or repository-wide prose cleanup.
- No expansion of comment validation.
- No generated ownership descriptor protocol or ADR for F05.
- No edits to ADR decision substance, ticket events, historical evidence, generated outputs, or protected evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] F01 is merged to main with both Gerrit gates passing.
- [x] F06 is merged to main after F01 with both Gerrit gates passing.
- [x] F07 is merged to main after F06 with both Gerrit gates passing.
- [x] Every child ticket is closed after its merged change is present on main.
- [x] The audit session log records the implementation and landing evidence.
